📦 **ArtGallery `2e5958e`** — feat(artgallery): exhibit Starpage Warden mechanical owl model

Add Sirius's original 196-part owl sculpture with an open book, brass star crown, enamel feathers and chest clock. Include editable Blender source, sculpture-only GLB, rendered thumbnail, exhibit card and self-contained interactive viewer.

Validation: gallery build and freshness check pass; 58,042 triangles with normals; embedded GLB matches the export byte for byte; repeat packing is deterministic. Gallery filtering, popup, standalone rotation/zoom/reset and both downloads verified. A restrictive CSP sandbox verifies zero external resource dependencies; direct file:// browser verification is unavailable in this environment.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

Blender glTF export can include other scenes even when selection is enabled. The source explicitly limits export to the active scene so existing sculptures and studio equipment cannot leak into this exhibit's GLB. This is an export setup detail within this artwork, so it needs no separate task.

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---
